text: He that being often reproved: Heb. a man of reproofs
he that receiveth gifts: Heb. a man of oblations
bring a city into a snare: Or, set a city on fire
The bloodthirsty: Heb. men of blood
the deceitful man: Or, the usurer
in his words?: Or, in his matters?
shall be safe: Heb. shall be set on high
the rulers favor: Heb. the face of a ruler
